shared_elements: low-relief carved human figures in profile
figure in dynamic pose, one apparently fallen or reclining below
band of glyph-like signs along the upper part of the surface
justification: Both surfaces show shallow-relief scenes of ornately costumed human figures in profile with plumed headdresses and streaming costume elements, with a standing/dominant figure above and a prone or fallen figure at the lower part, and both carry a register of glyph-like signs along the upper area. The differences are that A is a tall vertical panel dominated by a single columnar figure with a long column of glyphs at the side, while B is a broad slab with a multi-figure confrontation and a horizontal upper text band, so the compositional format differs even though the figural conventions are closely comparable.
